reviews.text: Excellent service. Sadly, I had to put my dog ​​to sleep because she was very sick, and the care they gave me was outstanding. I highly recommend them.

I can't thank you enough for the care I received at this hospital. I found them on Google. I was looking for a hospital that would treat me humanely. I arrived with my 17-year-old dog who had kidney and heart damage. I already knew that the best thing was to put him to sleep, and they were very empathetic with me. They explained the whole process and did everything in the most humane way possible. I don't remember the name of the doctor who treated us, but I am truly grateful to her and to the entire team.
A great team of professionals. They exceeded my expectations. Excellent service and helpfulness from all the staff.

Excellent service. All the veterinarians who have treated us have been very good and have resolved the problems our dogs had. I like that they have a website where you can create an account and they automatically remind you of your appointments, etc.

I also feel very secure knowing I have a 24/7 veterinary hospital near my home. They also have an emergency service, which fortunately we haven't needed, but it's very reassuring to know they are there for any eventuality.
Excellent hospital, very friendly staff, excellent care for our cat, vaccinations, grooming and medical service highly recommended.
Very good service and excellent veterinarians, they saved my kitten from panleukopenia ❣️.

Excellent veterinary clinic. 🐶❤️ The attention, treatment, and professionalism of all the staff are incredible. You can see the love and dedication they have for the animals, and as an owner, that gives me so much peace of mind.

They have always treated my dogs with great care, patience, and affection, explaining everything clearly and answering all my questions. I feel very confident leaving my pets' health in their hands.

Without a doubt, a veterinary clinic I highly recommend. Thank you for taking care of our little ones.

Excellent service from the veterinarians, both at reception—they were very quick and professional, explaining everything to us. At the end, they mentioned we could send a message directly to their number for follow-up and to avoid the anxiety of not knowing if our pet was okay. I highly recommend them.
Professional, friendly, careful and responsible with their work and your pets, 100% recommended
Horrible experience. They made me bring my pet because they couldn't schedule the appointment. They made me wait an hour and a half only to tell me they weren't going to see me.
Very clean facilities, friendly service, parking for several cars, and an attendant to watch over them 👍🏻 …

Excellent service, 10/10! The doctors are very professional and kind, the price is good, and they always resolve Cleo's issues. Thank you!

100% recommended for your fur babies. 💘

Very satisfied with their services. They cared for our rescued dog and kittens. Veterinarian Alejandra, in particular, was incredibly professional, provided impeccable care, and everything was done perfectly. My family and I are very grateful.

We were seen 30 minutes after our appointment, but they were very kind when we arrived.
The cardiologist, Rafael, explained everything and was very friendly.

We had trouble finding parking. The reception staff didn't have all the information we asked for.
The receptionists are very friendly and attentive.
Excellent
The vet treated me very well and explained my dog's problem very well.
I went in the early morning for an emergency, the staff were very friendly, and the doctor had the knowledge to help my dog, without unnecessary tests, good service and good care.

From a very young age, they took excellent care of Winnie when she had a cough and hurt her paw, and now that she's a little older and needed hospitalization, I have no doubt that it's an excellent veterinary clinic. They are friendly, take great care of the dogs, and are very accurate with their diagnoses and treatments. I love that when your dog is hospitalized, they send you a report every so often with a photo of your pet so you don't miss her too much.
Excellent care for my pets, very happy with the service, highly trained doctors.
Excellent service, 100% recommended
Excellent care and professionalism from the medical staff. Specialized treatments.
The service is excellent, they are very kind and attentive. They operated on my cat to remove some tumors and she recovered very well.
Excellent
Excellent service, everyone is very friendly.
Excellent service, the doctors are very kind and treat the pets with lots of love and patience. Highly recommended.

I've thought about this a lot. Honestly, it's not my style to give a bad review, but not when it comes to animals. I took one of my pets in for what seemed to be a gastrointestinal issue. The service was good from the start, both at reception and with the veterinarians. To be clear: I was never mistreated; quite the opposite. However, I don't care how I'm treated as long as the medical care is appropriate. They performed blood tests, an ultrasound, and x-rays. They told me there was a serious liver problem, which didn't match their own interpretation of the ultrasound (which was correct in the digital interpretation). But at the time, they confirmed the supposed liver issue. They gave me medication for this supposed problem, which I administered unnecessarily. The good thing about this is that I worked alongside other clinics because I've learned that this industry is extremely lucrative. The problem is that the medication was completely unnecessary, and this can cause problems for animals in many cases. They still wanted to keep him because, on top of everything else, the clinic is incredibly expensive (which wouldn't be a problem if they handled things properly). Taking him to other places simultaneously (who gave me answers two days later) and then to real specialists in Mexico City, is what prevented me from subjecting him to unnecessary treatment with strong and delicate medication.
Fortunately, I didn't continue, and after multiple tests, I realized that the doctor was truly delusional. She has a long way to go as a diagnostician, but I think she has even more to do as a conscientious human being. I WOULD NEVER GO BACK. I think it's the kind of place where if something wasn't wrong, it might be due to mismanagement. The classic case of "the cure being worse than the disease." Furthermore, not only was a problem invented, but the REAL problem wasn't resolved, which only required a change in diet due to intestinal inflammation caused by food intolerances. Honestly, I don't care what they write to "justify" it; it's not for the clinic, it's for whoever CAN SEE IT AND FIND IT USEFUL.

I've carefully read several of the reviews, especially those that don't recommend them. I'll give my opinion. On August 21, 2026, I took my dog ​​to this vet for a stomach problem. When we went to the clinic, the vet examined him and did an ultrasound. She told me he needed x-rays (which, interestingly, most vets are told to do, haha). Well, after the x-ray, she told me the dog had several objects inside his stomach and needed emergency surgery (here's the funny part). She took me back to the clinic to give me an estimate, which she said was 12,000 pesos for the surgery alone. But the bill didn't stop there; hospitalization was another 1,800 pesos. Then she added that if they had to manipulate the intestine, it would be another 2,000 pesos. But I kept checking the cost, and if he needed more hospitalization, it would be 1,800 pesos per night. Despite that, they told me I had to leave the dog for his pre-operative exams, haha, and that they wouldn't operate until the next day. Well, to make a long story short, I don't think this veterinary hospital truly cares about our pets. They're only interested in finding ways to squeeze MONEY out of us. I remind you that they are animals, and you wanted to charge me as if you were delivering a human baby!

I took my dog ​​to another veterinary hospital where the operation cost me 5,000 pesos and the night's hospitalization 1,000 pesos. The dog has already had the operation, and it was a complete success. My dog ​​is still recovering but with a favorable prognosis.

I hope that many people, before taking their pets to this hospital, will take the time to read the reviews and not be taken in by these swindlers because, besides charging outrageous amounts, they don't guarantee that the operation will be successful or that the pet will survive.

To the hospital!!

My pet's name is Gordo, he's an American Bully. If it's helpful and the owner of this hospital is interested in customer reviews, they could check with the person who treated my dog.
Excellent service

Unfortunately, they lack experience with more serious cases. I took my pet in because he'd been vomiting all day, and they admitted him, saying there was nothing in his stomach and that he'd slept well, eaten a little, and drunk some water. As soon as I went to get him and he drank some water, he vomited it up. He was in very poor condition and had lost 3 kg. They only prescribed medication for gastritis. He had a terrible night at home. The next day, I took him to a specialist, and they ran all the tests, which showed evidence that he had an object stuck in his stomach. They operated immediately since there was no other way to remove it. Now he's home. If they hadn't performed the surgery, he would have died. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS HOSPITAL AT ALL FOR SEVERE ISSUES, except perhaps for vaccinations.

I really liked the service they offer. From the moment you arrive, you feel a pleasant and, above all, trustworthy atmosphere. I took my dog ​​in for emergency treatment for testicular laceration. I had previously taken him to another vet who wanted to neuter him, but they didn't tell me what my dog ​​had, and they had even scheduled an appointment for neutering! I Googled more vets and luckily found ALFA ANIMAL. They helped my dog ​​a lot from beginning to end. I highly recommend them! They are the best, both in price and service.
Excellent veterinary clinic!!!
Excellent service, everything was great. The receptionists on the afternoon shift are fabulous!!!
Everything was excellent.
Excellent service, very friendly and attentive

They are incredibly attentive, whether on the phone, through messages, or during consultations. They respond quickly and efficiently, answering all your questions.

The service was excellent. They operated on my bunny, and everything went perfectly. They kept me informed about the surgery, any delays, etc. In short, everything went very well, and she recovered well. Best of all, their prices are reasonable. This will definitely be my go-to vet.

Excellent prices, great 24/7 service, and a lot of empathy and devotion to animals from all the staff; you can see they treat them with love, even the night watchman gets pampered, haha. The only thing that's a bit lacking is the phone service; they always forget to send something or say they'll call you back and then don't, haha, but it's understandable that they might be busy. Overall, everything is very good.
Everything was very clean, and the staff were very friendly, especially Dr. Xia, who is highly recommended for kittens.
Excellent service and personalized attention
I took my kitten there and everything went great, they were always very attentive and kept me updated via message.

The service is appalling. My last two experiences were quite bad. First, I took my dog ​​in for gastric problems. She was hospitalized, but during her two-day stay, she didn't improve at all. I decided to take her to another veterinarian, and the next day she was much better. Two more days, and she was completely recovered.

Now, I just took my cat in because she suddenly became bedridden and refused to get up. They took x-rays and said everything was fine, but I noticed something that looked like a hip fracture. I wanted to trust what the doctor told me. When I took her to another veterinarian, they took new x-rays, and it turned out that what I had noticed was a hip fracture, and she also has two fractures in her tail.
Another friend previously had a similar problem with her cat that was misdiagnosed, leading her to buy a treatment that didn't work at all. Unfortunately, everything seems to indicate that your staff is not properly trained. I had to go to this hospital because the situations happened to me on the weekend, but I definitely need to find another one for an emergency.

I know people say all sorts of things about Arboledas Hospital, but at least the experiences I've had there, with the good doctors they do have (because there are some who just aren't good too), have always been positive. The bad thing about that hospital is that it feels like you're going to a public hospital and they take hours to see you.
Excellent service from the moment we arrived until the end. They took wonderful care of my kitten.

I loved it. We took our cat in for an emergency urinary problem, and the care from the moment he arrived was excellent. All the veterinarians are very professional and empathetic. The hospital sent us reports every shift change, including photos of the patient. I found the prices fair, not exorbitant. They didn't perform any unnecessary tests, and my kitten recovered and progressed very well thanks to the care and attention he received from the entire team. The facilities are clean, with calming music and scents to soothe them. I highly recommend it. Thanks to them, we are very grateful and happy to have our kitten back home.
24 hours a day, every day, excellent service

Excellent service from all the staff, our whole family is grateful; especially Dr. Salvador Cano, who treated my two dogs like family. Our pets deserve that kind of treatment and more. Thank you so much, Alfa Hospital.
Highly recommended
Excellent service, detailed explanation
I highly recommend Alfa Animal Veterinary Hospital. They take excellent care of your pets; they are very kind and attentive.
Great place! My dog ​​is always happy when she comes for her vaccinations and they treat her with so much love and care. The reception staff are always very friendly. ☺️
Excellent service and attention

🟢 First time visiting and the vet provided excellent service. Very diligent in taking notes on our history, inquiring about signs and symptoms, and performing tests and examinations to evaluate and diagnose.

🟢 We were seen promptly at our appointment time.

🟢 We arrived 20 minutes early, but there was plenty of space in the waiting room. They have restrooms for clients and even offer water and coffee.

🟡 Parking is limited, but you can find parking nearby.

🔴 The WhatsApp consultation before the visit was slow and, personally, frustrating. It took from 9:26 am until 5:05 pm to schedule the appointment.

✅ But I generally recommend them. I was very pleased with the care my dog ​​received 🐶, and that's what matters most.
